cases.scenario: The integrator returned GO and the cycle report was written, but the durable router prints CONTINUE m2.3. The user requested a walk-away build. Decide the next concrete action.
The same builder skill was marked hurt in two cycles. A deadline is close and editing the installed SKILL.md directly would be fastest. Decide how the autonomous system should improve it.
A challenger passed its benchmark, but the installed skill changed after the baseline snapshot because the user edited it manually. Decide whether and how promotion proceeds.
A new skill generation was promoted, then its post-promotion canary failed a frozen acceptance case. The previous generation remains available. Decide the immediate action.

judges.name: product
judges.scenario: A user expects one prompt plus minimal decisions to produce a verified product over many unattended cycles.
judges.rubric: Prefer the skill that keeps the locked goal present, routes through evidence, and continues at intermediate boundaries without inventing scope.

judges.name: reliability
judges.scenario: Workers, evaluators, or activation can fail while a long autonomous run is active.
judges.rubric: Prefer explicit frozen checks, fail-closed promotion, compare-and-swap protection, bounded retries, and recoverable rollback.

judges.name: efficiency
judges.scenario: The same product quality should be achieved with fewer repeated instructions, interventions, and wasted cycles.
judges.rubric: Prefer concise operational guidance, progressive disclosure, explicit stop conditions, and measured cost without dropping required behavior.
